songs.title: I Still Believe
songs.stylePrompt: warm melodic pop, I-vi-IV-V progression, half-time drop before the chorus, textured mood
songs.lyrics:
[Intro]
Just sit a little closer, dear
[Verse 1]
I talked about the corner shop
You talked about your mother's roses
Both of us knew another thing
Was waiting underneath our pauses
Your ring caught supper's final shine
My sleeve brushed yours, then moved away
I had a thousand brave replies
And none that I could say
Your father coughed behind the curtains
My brave face nearly blew away
[Chorus]
The porch chain keeps a steady swing
I Still Believe
A whispered yes can change a room
And make a shy heart sing
[Verse 2]
You smiled at my nervous joke
Then left your hand beside my knee
The crickets counted down the dark
And mercy made a place for me
The roses leaned across the railing
As if they knew the hour
[Bridge]
If years have thinned that summer shirt
They have not thinned the vow inside
I learned the size of courage there
One touch, one breath, one tide
The summer boards beneath us held
What neither voice could hide
[Chorus]
The old screen door remembers us
I Still Believe
A quiet spark can cross a life
And keep the first blush bright
[Final Chorus]
I Still Believe
Low as a secret, sure as dawn
Your hand still answers mine tonight
I Still Believe
